page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top (inverted/show-through not transcribed). Decorative woodcut border, then heading "Periochæ Sectionum." Below, a single column of contents entries with a large initial S. Page number "VI." at the bottom right of the frame, and a faint "VIX" at bottom left, probably the printed foot line of the page number.

p.i: Quàm non sufficit eiusdem Symboli Confessio.
Impuratio Romanæ Ecclesiæ, & expertinaci illa fabula infallibilitatis, orta impossibilitas reconciliationis.

page.notes: The large initial S is set as a drop cap before "Tatus". The faint show-through text from the reverse of the leaf (e.g. "De Libero Arbitrio", "De Matrimonio", "De Purgatorio") is not transcribed. The bottom left "VIX" is a faint printed or show-through signature and is left out.
